system.description: A Methuselah-level power. The vampire spends a permanent Willpower Trait, three Blood Traits, and succeeds at a Static Physical Challenge; each Trait successfully risked rewinds one turn of time within line of sight, at a cost of one aggravated health level per turn rewound. The vampire must act differently than before or the attempt is wasted, replaying identical events. Only the wielder (and any observers with Time Attunement) retains memory of the undone events; usable once per scene.
system.duration: Once per scene, up to Traits risked in turns
